mapper.sql: r.status AS run_status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actions a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'cancelling')) AS has_active_actions FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.session_id = s.id AND r.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'cancelling')
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.revision, s.title, s.plan, s.updated_at, WHERE s.id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (id, project_id, title, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
